scope: Resource category codes are independent of terrain/vegetation/relief IDs and Tiled GIDs; multiple resources may share one cell.
water_contract: Water resources are baked into the actual water pass and excluded from Tiled visible objects. Clams remain partial/provisional43 treatment. Crab and whale groups preserve painted-waterline51; crab physical contact remains partial, whale is a prototype.
vineyard_contract: Wine stays a resource. Reusable aligned row modules assemble a globally phased ground field; vineyard presses stay separate upright improvements.
mineral_projection: Oil/Black ichor is ground_plane and scales height by projected cell height; all other deposits remain upright, isotropically scaled by cell width.
